//= Dull Armsmith (custom)
//===== Description: =========================================
//= The Dull weapons in three categories: Physical Melee, Physical Ranged, Magical & Support.
//= The price is the same for each item (item id:price in zeny).
//= Generated by srh_lite/tools/items/make_dull_shop.py
//============================================================

hero_ent3,65,128,4	script	Dull Armsmith	858,{
	mes "[Dull Armsmith]";
	mes "Weapons for every fighter.";
	mes "What kind are you looking for?";
	next;
	switch (select("Physical Melee:Physical Ranged:Magical & Support:Cancel")) {
	case 1: close2; callshop "pg_wshop_melee",1; end;
	case 2: close2; callshop "pg_wshop_ranged",1; end;
	case 3: close2; callshop "pg_wshop_magic",1; end;
	case 4: close;
	}
}
